verdict.rationale: Ramp's reimbursements page claims a Google Maps integration with automatic mileage calculation, and its travel page says per diem adjusts automatically by trip location and duration. Both come from single-line marketing claims. The per-diem claim is framed as showing travel purchasing allowances, not as a claimable per-diem reimbursement flow. Missing for 10: documentation of the employee mileage-logging workflow (route entry, rate application), evidence that per-diem rates can be claimed as reimbursements without manual entry, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
